title: Planet Tweaks V3.3.2 TITAN - Complete Hone, Aphrodite & Z-Tweaks Integration, Restored Icons, FilterKeys Live Studio
releaseNotes: Planet Tweaks V3.3.2 TITAN: (1) Restored Vibrant Icons across all top bar buttons, sidebar category headers, and navigation tabs. (2) Dedicated Aphrodite & Z-Tweaks Vault with 8000Hz USB High Speed Studio. (3) Hone Preset Converter with 1-click active PC registry scanner and share code importer. (4) FilterKeys Pro Live Repeat Rate Studio with interactive typing test box and dynamic status indicators. (5) Re-calibrated Peterbot Zero Delay (74 tweaks) and Pure Zero Delay (70 tweaks, 0 sensitivity tampering). (6) Scaled window size to 1220x750 for optimal laptop scaling.
